title: Disaster recovery with a warm standby region
summary: Primary and standby regions (or providers), backups with a one hour recovery point, and a documented switch over by DNS.

title: Payment gateway
summary: Payment API with idempotency cache, ordered event queue with dead letters, webhook dispatcher and a highly available ledger database.

title: Ecommerce storefront
summary: Storefront on Vercel or Render, commerce API and order worker on containers, Postgres, Redis sessions, an order queue and a product image bucket.

title: Logistics and shipment tracking
summary: Tracking API, ordered scan event ingestion, latest status cache and a document bucket for labels and proof of delivery.

title: Last mile delivery
summary: Customer tracking site, dispatch API, routing worker, courier location events and live positions, with the database on the provider of your choice.
